name: BASTA! Spring 2027
description: German .NET, architecture and AI conference with workshop days
note: Hybrid (on-site and online tickets); mostly German; early bird until 2026-11-12
details: BASTA! Frankfurt has workshop days on 1 and 5 March and conference days with an expo on 2-4 March 2027. Tracks: .NET & C#, software architecture, AI-driven software engineering, cloud native/DevOps, web & JavaScript, UI, data and application security. Prices exclude VAT: from 494 EUR for a workshop day, 869 EUR for a 2-day pass and 1,439 EUR for a 4-day pass, early-bird with team discount. Online tickets are offered too.
